description: WP-O6 Codex: Orks (11e) SUPREME KUNNIN' (Nazdreg, once per phase per army) through the real enemy_ended_move window. Fixture ork11e_ab_enemy_move: P2 (Custodes) is active. Custodian Guard B makes a 5" normal move (a real click selects it, the move is staged) ending within 8" of Nazdreg; a real click on 'End This Unit's Move' opens P1's window with the 0-CP 'Normal move up to D6"' option (not riled up: no 5" option); a real click starts Nazdreg's reactive move, staged 1" and ended with a real click.

steps.comment: stage U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_B 5.0" (per-model STAGE_MODEL_MOVE, as the drag tool sends)
stage U_NAZDREG_A 1.0" (per-model STAGE_MODEL_MOVE, as the drag tool sends)
